pokedexEntries.sw: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.sh: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

pokedexEntries.sc: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

pokedexEntries.vi: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.
